{{Hatnote|This page is printed Decipher cards plus original Virtual Sets 1–16 (2002–2008 PDF slips), including [[Defensive Shields]]. It is not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 16]].}}
'''Premiere - Original VS16''' is the constructed pool of printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] plus original [[Players Committee]] Virtual Sets 1–16. [[Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith|Virtual Set 16]] (Revenge Of The Sith) has official text as of 15 August 2008.<ref name="vs2002">[[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]</ref><ref name="vs16">[[Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith]]</ref><ref name="vc16">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards16.pdf VirtualCards16.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks</ref> The pool includes [[Defensive Shields]] (between original Virtual Sets 11 and 12). [[Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed|Virtual Set 17]] has official text as of 6 February 2009, after this cutoff. The short name '''POVS16''' redirects here.

The [[2008 World Championship]] (Minneapolis, 10–12 October 2008) was played in this pool.<ref name="dl2008">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2008-decklists/ 2008 Decklists], starwarsccg.org</ref>
